vectors.name: address_verification_request
vectors.description: Address Verification request for the alias "main" at m/84'/1'/0'/0/7, with all three optional fields present: the address bc1qxyz, a FORM 0x01 descriptor wpkh([00000000/84h/1h/0h]xpub/0/*), and a POR of 4 bytes of 0x5a.

vectors.name: address_verification_response_uri
vectors.description: Address Verification ok response with URI present and equal to bitcoin:bc1qxyz. This is the worked example of the spec.

vectors.name: address_verification_response_no_uri
vectors.description: Address Verification ok response with no URI, so the whole body is the single PRESENCE byte 0x00.
